userInteractions.request: User pointed out the design is missing the flow for when the user does NOT approve the plan (rejection/revision path)

userInteractions.request: User said there should be no 'reject' option — only approve or request changes

userInteractions.agentResponse: Removing reject path from flow diagram and substep 10. Only approve and request-changes remain.
